record.original_question: Let Theta_{a,b} and g_d^(a,b)(x;q,t) be as above. For a partition mu of d, let m_hat_mu(x) = (-1)^(d-length(mu)) m_mu(x) be the normalized monomial symmetric-function seed and let f_hat_mu(x) = (-qt)^(-(length(mu)-1)) f_mu(x) be the normalized forgotten symmetric-function seed. For every partition mu of d and every coprime pair of positive integers a and b, prove that both m_hat_mu^(a,b)(x;q,t) and f_hat_mu^(a,b)(x;q,t) are Schur-positive. Can these Schur-positive expressions be realized as bigraded Frobenius characteristics of suitable bigraded S_n-modules?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Fix coprime positive integers $a,b\ge 1$ and consider the family of symmetric-function operators $\Theta_{a,b}$ acting on the algebra $\Lambda_{\mathbb{Q}(q,t)}$ of symmetric functions in variables $x=(x_1,x_2,\dots)$ with coefficients in $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$. For each partition $\mu$ of an integer $d$, write $g^{(a,b)}_d(x;q,t)$ for the canonical degree-$d$ "rectangular Catalan" symmetric function associated with the pair $(a,b)$, and let $F^{(a,b)}_\mu(x;q,t)$ denote the image, under the rectangular Catalan operator parametrized by $\mu$, of the seed $F_\mu(x)$ (with $F$ either the monomial basis $m$ or the forgotten basis $f$). Concretely, the rectangular construction associates to every symmetric-function seed $F_\mu$ a symmetric function $F^{(a,b)}_\mu(x;q,t)\in\Lambda_{\mathbb{Q}(q,t)}$ that reduces to $g^{(a,b)}_d$ when $\mu=(d)$.

Normalized seeds. For a partition $\mu\vdash d$ with $\ell(\mu)$ parts, define the normalized monomial seed
$$\widehat{m}_\mu(x) := (-1)^{d-\ell(\mu)}\, m_\mu(x),$$
and the normalized forgotten seed
$$\widehat{f}_\mu(x) := (-qt)^{-(\ell(\mu)-1)}\, f_\mu(x),$$
where $m_\mu$ and $f_\mu$ are the monomial and forgotten symmetric functions, respectively. Let $\widehat{m}^{(a,b)}_\mu(x;q,t)$ and $\widehat{f}^{(a,b)}_\mu(x;q,t)$ denote the resulting symmetric functions obtained by applying the rectangular Catalan construction to these normalized seeds.

Problem. Prove that for every coprime pair of positive integers $(a,b)$ and every partition $\mu\vdash d$, both 
$$\widehat{m}^{(a,b)}_\mu(x;q,t) \quad\text{and}\quad \widehat{f}^{(a,b)}_\mu(x;q,t)$$
are Schur-positive; that is, when expanded in the Schur basis $\{s_\lambda\}_\lambda$, all coefficients lie in $\mathbb{N}[q,t]$. Further, determine whether these Schur-positive expansions can be realized as the bigraded Frobenius characteristics of suitable bigraded representations of the symmetric group $S_d$ (or $S_n$ for an appropriate $n$).
artifact.category_tag: Schur positivity and rectangular Catalan operators
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as one of several explicit open questions on Schur positivity for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics. Subsequent literature (e.g., work on Catalan functions and k-Schur positivity, Demazure crystals) addresses adjacent positivity problems but does not establish Schur positivity of the normalized monomial and forgotten seeds under the rectangular operators for all coprime $(a,b)$ and all $\mu$, nor a bigraded $S_n$-module realization. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates open questions on Schur positivity for various seeds under operators associated with coprime pairs (a,b).
status_evidence.claim: The Schur positivity of normalized monomial and forgotten seeds under rectangular Catalan operators is posed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Demazure crystals and the Schur positivity of Catalan functions
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Schur positivity for Catalan functions indexed by partition weight via Demazure crystals.
status_evidence.claim: Recent advances settle related but distinct Schur positivity conjectures; they do not cover the normalized monomial/forgotten seed conjectures here.

status_evidence.title: Catalan functions and k-Schur positivity
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the theory of Catalan functions and proves k-Schur positivity in cases relevant to rectangular Catalan combinatorics.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial progress on the broader Schur positivity program but does not resolve the stated normalized-seed conjectures.
